We need functional groups broken/formed. For HWE forward reaction: forms C-C double bond (alkene) and aliphatic carboxylic acid (product). Broken: carbon-phosphorus bond (phosphonate) and carbon-oxygen bond (maybe C-O of phosphonate). The functional groups formed: "C-C double bonds", "aliphatic carboxylic acid". Broken: maybe "phosphonate"? Not in list. Could use "phosphonate" not available. Could use "alkyl halide"? Not. Maybe we can just specify functional_groups_formed list with those two names, and functional_groups_broken empty. That satisfies at least one criteria.

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_formed = ["C-C double bonds", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"].
